mapping_notice: Indicative mapping example only. This scanner does not implement every CIS requirement, this mapping is not a certification, and control assessment may require additional evidence or manual review.

controls.title: IAM policies should not allow full administrative privileges
controls.rationale: IAM-001 detects unrestricted IAM permissions. This check does not prove that every identity or policy in the account has been discovered.

controls.title: IAM root user access key should not exist
controls.rationale: IAM-014 identifies an active root-account access key when that account-level evidence is available.

controls.title: MFA should be enabled for the root user
controls.rationale: IAM-013 evaluates the observed root MFA state.

controls.title: KMS key rotation should be enabled
controls.rationale: KMS-001 evaluates rotation for customer-managed KMS keys within the discovered scope.

controls.title: CloudTrail should be enabled with a multi-Region trail and management events
controls.rationale: The checks cover trail logging, multi-Region configuration and observed management-event selector coverage. They do not establish that all accounts and regions have been assessed unless discovery coverage is complete.

controls.title: CloudTrail log file validation should be enabled
controls.rationale: CT-003 evaluates the observed CloudTrail log-file validation setting.

controls.title: CloudTrail trails should be integrated with CloudWatch Logs
controls.rationale: CT-004 reviews CloudWatch Logs integration for discovered trails; inaccessible trail metadata remains an assessment gap.

controls.title: S3 buckets should require requests to use TLS
controls.rationale: S3-007 evaluates whether the observed bucket policy enforces TLS. This mapping does not establish complete bucket discovery.

controls.title: S3 buckets should block public access
controls.rationale: The checks cover observed bucket public exposure and bucket/account Block Public Access settings, but do not replace the full CIS assessment procedure.
